description: This file defines the implementation of the GenericPlayerTaskFactory class, which creates various task objects related to media playback control in a GStreamer-based media player. It includes methods for creating tasks such as attach source, play, pause, set volume, handle bus messages, and more, all encapsulated as unique pointers to IPlayerTask objects.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::server::GenericPlayerTaskFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating various media playback tasks related to a GStreamer media player.
